# Step 1: Login to Spotify and fetch the current song queue
spotify_password = None
for item in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if item['account_name'] == 'spotify':
        spotify_password = item['password']
print('spotify_password_loaded:', spotify_password is not None)

login_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='ca-smit@gmail.com', password=spotify_password)
print('login_resp:', login_resp)

access_token = login_resp['access_token']
queue_resp = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token)
print('queue_resp:', queue_resp)

queue_resp = globals().get('queue_resp', None)
print('queue_len:', len(queue_resp))
current = [s for s in queue_resp if s.get('is_current')]
print('current_items:', current)
current_pos = current[0]['position'] if current else None
played_so_far = [s for s in queue_resp if s['position'] <= current_pos]
print('current_pos:', current_pos)
print('played_so_far_ids:', [s['song_id'] for s in played_so_far])
played_so_far_titles = [(s['song_id'], s['title'], [a['name'] for a in s['artists']]) for s in played_so_far]
print('played_so_far_titles:', played_so_far_titles)

# Fetch all liked songs to compute which queued songs still need liking
access_token = login_resp['access_token']
liked_ids = set()
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
all_liked = []
while True:
    resp = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page_index', page_index, 'resp_len', len(resp))
    if not resp:
        break
    for s in resp:
        liked_ids.add(s['song_id'])
    all_liked.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1
    if page_index > 50:
        break
print('total_liked_songs_fetched:', len(all_liked))
print('liked_ids_sample:', sorted(list(liked_ids))[:10])

queued_played_so_far_ids = [2, 91, 168, 137, 250, 227]
need_like_ids = [sid for sid in queued_played_so_far_ids if sid not in liked_ids]
already_liked_ids = [sid for sid in queued_played_so_far_ids if sid in liked_ids]
print('Already in target state:', already_liked_ids, len(already_liked_ids))
print('Need action:', need_like_ids, len(need_like_ids))

# Prepare verification table mapping id -> title/artists from queue
queue_by_id = {s['song_id']: s for s in queue_resp}
verification_rows = []
for sid in queued_played_so_far_ids:
    s = queue_by_id.get(sid)
    verification_rows.append({'song_id': sid, 'title': s['title'] if s else None, 'artists': [a['name'] for a in s['artists']] if s else None, 'in_liked': sid in liked_ids})
print('verification_rows:', verification_rows)
